messages:
ajay: heads up – seeing blk_checksum_mismatch on /dev/nvme0n1 and gpu provisioning failing in eu-west3 since the peering cutover. hitting 200+ failures in last 5m.

maria: ugh. any pattern by instance type or scratchpool?

ajay: mostly c4g-gpu* nodes, ephemeral SSDs. logs show metadata read errors, then overlayfs remount readonly. example logs:
```
[1748000987] nvme0: blk_checksum_mismatch metadata=0x1f2a
[1748000990] overlayfs: upperdir remount readonly
[1748000991] gpu-allocator: attach failed: scratch unavailable
```

doris: did peering rollback happen? net team cut routes 2m before spike.

ajay: yes, peering change at 1748000940. correlation strong.

sam: possible io amplification from scrub + network-induced replication delays. Are scrub jobs running? scrubber metrics?

maria: scrubber was in window, but we had delayed ACKs; ephemeral cleaner backlog spiked to 70%.

ajay: I think metadata IOs timed out leading to checksum failures. Plan: cordon affected nodes, disable scrub on them, force remount read-write if safe. thoughts?

doris: +1 cordon. also collect SMART and nvme-cli logs: `nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0` and `nvme id-ctrl`

infra-bot: incident-created: #INC-2026-331 nvme-metadata-drift-euw3 (severity: high) assigned: eng-infra oncall

sam: I'll start cordon and draining now. @ajay pls paste command to list nodes by checksum error.

ajay: run:
```
kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NODE:.metadata.name,ERRS:.metadata.annotations.nvme_errors | grep checksum
```
I'll push a quick scrub-disable patch to the janitor scheduler.

maria: note to ops: fallback routing to us-west1 should be enabled for provisioning during this window to avoid customer impact.

doris: after cordon, run `fsck -n` on the mounts before forcing remount. avoid write if corruption suspected.

ajay: cordon started. draining 4 nodes. will post update in 15m.

sam: draining done on 4 nodes, provisioning healthy now for new requests. removing one scrub job from scheduler.

ajay: found 2 nodes with persistent nvme controller errors. opening reimage ticket.

infra-bot: update: #INC-2026-331 severity->critical, ETA fix 60m

maria: thanks, team. we'll keep routing and monitor SLOs. set alert threshold lower for nvme checksum in eu-west3.
